A cleaning team that asks the right questions

Plano homeowners tend to know exactly what they want — and they notice when a cleaner just "sweeps and leaves." That's why we start every new home by listening: which rooms matter most, what surfaces need special care, what's driving you crazy right now. Then we clean to that.

Plano homes also tend to be on the larger side: two-story floor plans, open kitchens with big islands, multiple full bathrooms, high ceilings and tall windows. More square footage means more baseboards, more fan blades and more glass. It's exactly the kind of work we slow down for.

From the established neighborhoods of east and central Plano to the newer builds out west near Legacy and the Dallas North Tollway, our maid service brings the same checklist and the same care.

The best way to clean a Plano home

1. Start with a deep clean. Large homes collect dust in places you don't look every day: ceiling fans in two-story family rooms, blinds and long runs of baseboard. A deep clean resets all of it, with baseboard cleaning down every long hallway, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), and a detailed bathroom cleaning in every bath.

2. Keep it there with recurring cleaning. Every-other-week service is the best value for most Plano families — you get our reduced recurring rate, and your home stays guest-ready between visits.

3. Moving? Book a move-in / move-out clean. Plano's housing market keeps moving, and an empty-home clean is the easiest way to impress buyers or start fresh in your new place.

Also available: standard cleaning for homes already in good shape, plus appliance cleaning add-ons (inside the oven and refrigerator) on any standard clean. Both are included in every deep clean.

Have pets? Our pet-friendly house cleaning focuses on the hair on your floors, furniture and baseboards. We also offer apartment and condo cleaning, one-time cleaning, Airbnb turnovers, post-construction cleaning and office cleaning.

What a Plano deep clean covers

  • Walls and baseboards spot-cleaned throughout, including long hallways
  • Ceiling fans and light fixtures dusted (reachable heights)
  • Blinds dusted and window sills wiped
  • Light switches and outlet covers wiped
  • Kitchen: counters, island, backsplash, sink, stovetop and drip pans, range hood exterior, cabinet fronts and handles, plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty
  • Appliances: outside of the fridge, oven and microwave, plus inside the microwave, oven and fridge
  • Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, soap scum, tile grout, sinks, counters, vanity fronts and mirrors
  • Upholstered furniture vacuumed
  • All floors vacuumed and mopped, including under beds and along edges

Small-business care, without the hassle

  • Clear communication. Our English-speaking cleaners make it easy to ask for something specific, and we'll follow up with questions to get it right.
  • Background-checked team members you can trust in your home while you're at work.
  • Upfront pricing. See your price online based on your home's size before you book.
  • Flexible scheduling. Open seven days a week, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM, with online booking any time.
  • Your products or ours. Professional-grade, eco-conscious products, or the ones you prefer for your stone, wood or specialty finishes.

Do you clean large homes?

Yes. Our pricing is based on square footage, so larger homes get the time they need — and you see the price before you book.

Can you clean while I'm at work?

Yes. Many clients leave a key or entry code and come home to a clean house.

Do you clean high windows and tall fans?

We clean what can be safely reached. Let us know about any high areas in your booking notes and we'll tell you what we can do.

Do you offer recurring discounts in Plano?

Yes — reduced rates for weekly, every-other-week and monthly clients apply in Plano just like everywhere else we serve.
